tools.name: CodeQL
tools.purpose: Supported-language source security analysis; verify repository entitlement and existing scanning first

tools.name: Gitleaks
tools.purpose: Redacted secret detection in staged changes and CI; no baseline of unexplained findings

tools.name: Trivy
tools.purpose: Explicit vulnerability/image/IaC scope; avoid redundant secret scanning and do not hide database failures

tools.name: ShellCheck
tools.purpose: Supported shell scripts including extensionless scripts and selected CI shell blocks

tools.name: Hadolint
tools.purpose: Maintained Dockerfiles; inspect nonstandard names and vendor boundaries

tools.name: Renovate
tools.purpose: Scoped dependency update PRs without default automerge or duplicate Dependabot ownership

tools.name: Lefthook
tools.purpose: Local hook orchestration only where no healthy existing owner exists; CI remains authoritative

tools.name: just
tools.purpose: Optional task facade; preserve native diagnosis commands and existing task ownership

tools.name: mise
tools.purpose: Explicit runtime/task adoption; no automatic SDKMAN/nvm/toolchain migration or trust of unknown config

tools.name: OpenRewrite
tools.purpose: Requested Java/Spring migration via pinned recipe and dry run; project stack alone does not authorize source rewrites
